numValidDiagrams.description:
The number of {@link LabeledDiagram}s in the input data that will be randomly selected as the
validation set for early stopping in the training process. The value of this field must be
greater than 0.

targetsOverride.description:
Target symbols that the detector can detect. If the target labels the user want to detect are
different from the ones in the previously trained {@link TwoStageSymbolDetectionPipe#proposer}
and {@link TwoStageSymbolDetectionPipe#classifier}, the user can override the targets here. Notice
that if {@link TwoStageSymbolDetectionPipe#proposer} and {@link TwoStageSymbolDetectionPipe#classifier}
are not specified before {@link TwoStageSymbolDetectionPipe#train}, the pipe will use the default
pre-trained proposers and classifiers which have targets determined by {@link DiagramParsingMLConfig},
i.e., `c3.DiagramParsingMLConfig.inst().configValue("targets")`

anchorBoxShapesOverride.description:
Anchor boxes that are rough estimate of the target object sizes, the closer the number is, the easier
the task for the model to learn. If this field is not specified, the pipe will use the same anchor boxes
the previously trained {@link TwoStageSymbolDetectionPipe#proposer}. Notice that if
{@link TwoStageSymbolDetectionPipe#proposer} is not specified before {@link TwoStageSymbolDetectionPipe#train},
the pipe will use a default pre-trained proposer which has a wide range of anchor box shapes.

proposerTrainingSpec.description: Parameters controlling the model training behavior of a region proposer.

classifierTrainingSpec.description: Parameters controlling the model training behavior of an region classifier.
